_comment: A demo scenario, not a Django fixture. `seed_demo_agency` reads this and builds the
rows through the real services — the pricer, the promo reserver, the supplier gateway,
the commission calculator — so the result obeys every constraint and validation the
live system has. A loaddata fixture would bypass all of them and could encode totals
that the pricer would never produce.
Edit this file to change the story. Nothing here is hardcoded in the command.
_plan_mix_comment: Weighted by what a pilgrim on a 10-14 night trip actually buys. The 10 GB plan
dominates because the trip is long enough to need it and video calls home are the
main use. The 1 GB/7-day is rare — it does not cover the trip — but a few budget
travellers take it anyway, and a demo that hides that hides a real support case.
_realism_comment: Distributions taken from what this platform's own production data actually looked
like, not invented. `never_installed` and `installed_not_activated` exist because
both happened to real customers here: one had the eSIM on the phone with Data
Roaming off and no signal, which is the single most common support ticket.
`payment_failed` keeps a few unhappy rows on the screen, because a demo where every
order succeeds teaches an operator nothing about where to look when one does not.
_names_comment: Kerala-origin names — Alhind Travels is a Kozhikode operator and its Umrah groups are overwhelmingly Malayali.
